text.en:
MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 510 July 18, 1974
FURTHER EXTENDING THE EFFECTIVITY OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 333, AS AMENDED,
AFFECTING THE IMPORTATION OF LIQUEFIED PETROLEUM GAS
WHEREAS, at the height of the energy crisis, the country suffered from the cutback of crude oil and
experienced an acute shortage of petroleum products;
WHEREAS, in the face of this shortage temporary measures were enacted to lift protective tariffs and allow
for the duty-free importation of the scarce petroleum products vital to the country's economic growth;
WHEREAS, the oil situation has relatively improved and it has been assessed that the country at present
possesses adequate supplies of petroleum products, except for liquefied petroleum gas, a widely-used
commercial, industrial and domestic fuel;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by the Constitution, do hereby order and decree that the effectivity of Presidential Decree No.
333, as amended, by Presidential Decree No. 343, Presidential Decree No. 368 and Presidential Decree No.
438 be further extended as this affects the duty-free importation of liquefied petroleum gas only up to 30 June
1975 unless sooner terminated by the President.
This Decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 18th day of July, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-four.
